versions.content: If a DCM_E_PENDING value is returned from an operation using the Dcm_OpStatusType, the Dcm call the operation on each Dcm_MainFunction call with OpStatus = DCM_PENDING as long as DCM_E_PENDING is returned.

If a DCM_E_PENDING value is returned from an operation using the Dcm_OpStatusType, the Dcm call the operation on each Dcm_MainFunction call with OpStatus = DCM_PENDING as long as DCM_E_PENDING is returned.

If a DCM_E_PENDING value is returned from an operation using the Dcm_OpStatusType, the Dcm call the operation on each Dcm_MainFunction call with OpStatus = DCM_PENDING as long as DCM_E_PENDING is returned.

If a DCM_E_PENDING value is returned from an operation using the Dcm_OpStatusType, the Dcm call the operation on each Dcm_MainFunction call with OpStatus = DCM_PENDING as long as DCM_E_PENDING is returned.
